definitions.gloss: inner feelings, inner self, psychological interior
definitions.explanation: A person's inner thoughts, emotions, and psychological state, as opposed to their outward appearance or behavior.
The interior surface or inside of a physical object.

examples.japanese: {外見|がいけん}だけでなく{内面|ないめん}も{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Not just appearance but inner qualities are also important.

examples.japanese: この{小説|しょうせつ}は{主人公|しゅじんこう}の{内面|ないめん}を{深|ふか}く{描|えが}いている。
examples.english: This novel deeply portrays the protagonist's inner world.

examples.japanese: パイプの{内面|ないめん}を{清掃|せいそう}する。
examples.english: Clean the inner surface of the pipe.

examples.japanese: {壁|かべ}の{内面|ないめん}に{断熱材|だんねつざい}を{入|い}れる。
examples.english: Insert insulation material on the inner surface of the wall.

examples.japanese: ヘルメットの{内面|ないめん}にクッションが{付|つ}いている。
examples.english: There is cushioning on the inside of the helmet.

notes:
Sense 1 is far more common in everyday usage. Often contrasted with {外見|がいけん} (outward appearance) or {外面|がいめん} (exterior).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{内面|ないめん}を{磨|みが}く (polish one's inner self, cultivate character)
・{内面|ないめん}の{美|うつく}しさ (inner beauty)
・{内面|ないめん}{的|てき} (internal, psychological)
・{内面|ないめん}{描写|びょうしゃ} (depiction of inner feelings)

DISTINCTIONS:
・{内面|ないめん}: inner side / inner self (broad — physical or psychological)
・{内心|ないしん}: one's true feelings (always psychological, often hidden)
・{外面|がいめん}: exterior, outward appearance
